title: After-image effect prevents diagonal character movement
description:
With the haste/slow after-image effects active, characters cannot move diagonally in the lobby. They are restricted to moving either:
- Straight up/down (vertical only)
- Forward/backward (horizontal only)

Without haste/slow effects, diagonal movement works normally.

Expected: After-image effect should not interfere with movement controls
Actual: After-images seem to be locking movement to cardinal directions only

This is a regression - likely the after-image rendering or position tracking logic is interfering with the movement input handling.

Affected files:
- client/src/components/game/Lobby.tsx (after-image logic, movement handling)
- Possibly PlayerController movement input code

Related issues:
- ScrumQuest-9o3 (after-image vertical tracking)

Priority: This significantly impacts lobby UX when using haste/slow

title: Design and implement PhaseCoordinator
description:
Design and implement PhaseCoordinator for centralized phase management.

OVERVIEW:
PhaseCoordinator replaces scattered phase mutations with event-driven coordination.
Uses hybrid architecture: domains emit events → PhaseCoordinator transitions → domains react.

SUB-TASKS:
- ScrumQuest-ve1: Phase 1 - Core Infrastructure (2-3 hrs)
- ScrumQuest-0rj: Phase 2-4 - Integration & Migration (4-6 hrs)
- ScrumQuest-9o4: Phase 5-6 - Testing & Polish (3-4 hrs)

TOTAL ESTIMATE: 9-13 hours

DESIGN DECISIONS (approved):
- Event-driven coordination (domain events → phase changes)
- Domains provide validators (hasAllVotes(), areAllPlayersDowned())
- Hybrid state machine (normal flow + emergency exits)
- Re-validation before transitions (correctness over performance)
- Facade pattern migration (coexist with gameState)

DELIVERABLES:
- PhaseCoordinator class operational
- 20 phase transitions centralized
- State machine validation
- Comprehensive tests (95%+ coverage)
- Documentation updated

BLOCKS:
- ScrumQuest-z9s (Estimation handlers)
- ScrumQuest-2n3 (Combat handlers)
- ScrumQuest-jd9 (GameFlowManager)

See /plan.md for detailed implementation plan.
close_reason: PhaseCoordinator implementation complete across all 6 phases. 458 tests passing. Zero direct phase mutations. Full architecture documentation. All sub-tasks (ve1, 0rj, 9o4) closed.
